name: harness-eval-claude-code-sdk-driver
description: The Agent SDK driver of the Claude Code harness (sdk-driver.ts): @anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk at the release whose claudeCodeVersion is the CLI's pin. Installed under /opt/harness with npm ci --omit=optional --legacy-peer-deps, so neither the SDK's bundled CLI binary nor its peer packages are in the image.
